summary: Rosnet is a restaurant back-office software provider (inventory, labor/scheduling, food-cost management) used by multi-unit chains including Wingstop, Blaze Pizza, Buffalo Wild Wings, Panera Bread, Applebee's, Dunkin', and Little Caesars locations, with Rosnet reporting that customers average roughly 2 percentage points of food-cost improvement within 18 months. (Scope note: Brand list reflects vendor-published client logos/mentions; scope (number of locations per brand actually on Rosnet) is not broken out.)

Maggie Peters is CEO of Rosnet; Derek Slayton was appointed President in August 2025 to work alongside Peters to accelerate growth, following a strategic investment in Rosnet by M33 Growth. (Scope note: Public sources show some conflicting/outdated CEO name listings on third-party aggregator sites (e.g., 'Gene Peters'); this finding relies on the company's own August 2025 press release naming Maggie Peters as CEO.)
